name: PDF Wizard
onCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ffmpeg && pip install --user -r media-worker/requirements.txt python-docx openpyxl && npm ci

NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL.description: Supabase project URL. Accounts, library and billing need it; the tools do not.

SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.description: Supabase service-role key, used by the Stripe webhook.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Enables the Ask a PDF assistant.

MEDIA_WORKER_SECRET.description: Shared secret between the web app and the media worker.
